name: Broadcast Notifications
description: Create storewide promotional announcements, targeted alerts, and modal popups with engagement analytics.
author: Nasrify Core

enablePopup.label: Enable Broadcast Popup
enablePopup.description: Display active broadcast modal popup to visitors on storefront load

popupPosition.label: Popup Position
popupPosition.description: Screen positioning for the broadcast announcement modal

popupDelaySeconds.label: Popup Delay (Seconds)
popupDelaySeconds.description: Number of seconds to wait before displaying broadcast popup

showOncePerCustomer.label: Show Once Per Visitor
showOncePerCustomer.description: Do not show the same broadcast again once dismissed or viewed by the visitor

enableExpiryDate.label: Enable Auto-Expiry
enableExpiryDate.description: Automatically hide broadcasts that have exceeded their scheduled expiration date

maxActiveBroadcasts.label: Max Active Broadcasts
maxActiveBroadcasts.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active broadcast campaigns displayed
